lines.zh: 拖着腿走，泥土粘在脚踝上。
lines.en: I drag my legs; the wet soil clings to my ankles.

lines.zh: 每走一步，骨头在皮里响一下。
lines.en: Each step, my bones knock inside the skin.

lines.zh: 我不踩草，草自己让开。
lines.en: I don't bend the grass; it shrinks away from me.

lines.zh: 从坟头走到田边，只用了一夜。
lines.en: From the grave mound to the field took one night.

lines.zh: 脚底没有声音，只有土层在动。
lines.en: No footfall, only the dirt shifting underneath.

lines.zh: 我的影子总比我慢半步。
lines.en: My shadow always trails half a step behind me.

lines.zh: 风穿过我，像穿过破篮子。
lines.en: The wind passes through me like a torn basket.

lines.zh: 我记得这条路，虽然不记得为什么。
lines.en: I know this path, though I forget why.

lines.zh: 往那边走，那边有我熟悉的味道。
lines.en: I head that way; something there smells familiar.

lines.zh: 腿僵了，可它还是往前走。
lines.en: My legs have stiffened, yet they keep going.

lines.zh: 踩断枯枝，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I snap a dead twig; the sound carries far.

lines.zh: 泥土从裤脚一路撒到身后。
lines.en: Soil spills from my cuffs all the way behind me.

lines.zh: 胸口里空着，什么也不跳。
lines.en: My chest is hollow; nothing beats in it.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，只是站着。
lines.en: I do not breathe; I merely stand.

lines.zh: 腐肉在口袋里发软了。
lines.en: The rotten flesh in my pocket has gone soft.

lines.zh: 夜里安静，我能听见虫爬。
lines.en: The night is quiet; I hear insects crawl.

lines.zh: 眼皮干了，闭不上。
lines.en: My eyelids dried out; they will not close.

lines.zh: 我数着坟头的草，数到七。
lines.en: I count the grass on the graves, up to seven.

lines.zh: 身上有股湿土的味道。
lines.en: I smell of wet earth and old rain.

lines.zh: 站着不动时，虫子爬上我的肩。
lines.en: Standing still, beetles climb onto my shoulder.

lines.zh: 月光照进来，我不觉得冷。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on me; I feel no cold.

lines.zh: 手指弯不回来了。
lines.en: My fingers no longer bend back straight.

lines.zh: 我等天黑得再深一点。
lines.en: I wait for the dark to deepen a little.

lines.zh: 有人路过，又加快了脚步。
lines.en: Someone passed by, then walked much faster.

lines.zh: 这块墓碑上的字被雨磨平了。
lines.en: Rain has worn the letters off this headstone.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我还是想吃。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet I still want to eat.

lines.zh: 你身上是热的，我闻得到。
lines.en: You are warm; I can smell it on you.

lines.zh: 别回头，我已经看着你了。
lines.en: Don't turn around; I am already watching you.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太响了。
lines.en: Your breathing is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我认得这张脸，上次也是你。
lines.en: I know that face; it was you last time.

lines.zh: 你站着的样子，很像一块肉。
lines.en: Standing like that, you look like meat.

lines.zh: 我数过你的脚步，一共十二。
lines.en: I counted your steps; there were twelve.

lines.zh: 你在看我？那就别动。
lines.en: You're looking at me? Then hold still.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛亮得刺人。
lines.en: Living eyes shine too sharply for me.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把让我退后。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes me step back.

lines.zh: 我看不见瞳孔，但看得见你。
lines.en: I have no pupils, but I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你走快一点，我就跟快一点。
lines.en: Walk faster, and I will follow faster.

lines.zh: 这张脸我埋过，真的。
lines.en: I buried that face once, truly I did.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow is trembling; I dislike that.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就能碰到你。
lines.en: One step closer and I can reach you.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮我半张脸，够吗。
lines.en: Your torch lights half my face. Enough?

lines.zh: 我站在你视线的边上，不动。
lines.en: I stand at the edge of your sight, still.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫，我近了一步。
lines.en: In one blink of yours I take a step.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，我就退进暗处。
lines.en: Raise the lamp and I slide into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，我的肩膀塌了。
lines.en: That blow went wide; my shoulder caved in.

lines.zh: 我不疼，只是有条胳膊不听使唤。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; one arm just stopped obeying.

lines.zh: 刀口翻出旧棉絮，没有血。
lines.en: The cut shows old cotton, not blood.

lines.zh: 退两步，让我把骨头摆回去。
lines.en: Two steps back while I set my bone again.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的膝盖，我照样站。
lines.en: You broke my knee; I still stand.

lines.zh: 这一箭钉在我背上，拔不出来。
lines.en: This arrow is stuck in my back and won't come out.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又直起来。
lines.en: I tilted, then straightened up again.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事，我早忘了。
lines.en: Pain is for the living; I forgot it long ago.

lines.zh: 腐肉从我口袋里掉出去一块。
lines.en: A piece of rotten flesh slipped from my pocket.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，我的皮都松了。
lines.en: You hit hard; my skin has gone loose.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，隔着一堵墙也行。
lines.en: Rotten flesh; I can smell it through a wall.

lines.zh: 把腐肉放下，我就慢慢过去。
lines.en: Set the rotten flesh down and I'll come slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那块，是我的口粮。
lines.en: That piece in your hand is my meal.

lines.zh: 腐肉越烂，我越走不动路。
lines.en: The rottener the flesh, the weaker my knees.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道，不看路。
lines.en: I follow the smell and ignore the road.

lines.zh: 僵尸的口袋里常有我想要的。
lines.en: Zombies often carry what I want in their pockets.

lines.zh: 那块肉在滴，我听见了。
lines.en: That meat is dripping; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 腐肉对我像灯火对飞蛾。
lines.en: Rotten flesh draws me like a lamp draws moths.

lines.zh: 别把它埋了，埋了我也挖。
lines.en: Don't bury it; I will dig it up anyway.

lines.zh: 我咬不动骨头，只挑软的。
lines.en: I can't chew bone; I only take the soft parts.

lines.zh: 撞到你了？我身上比木头凉。
lines.en: Did I bump you? I am colder than wood.

lines.zh: 别推，我的肩膀会散。
lines.en: Don't shove; my shoulder might come apart.

lines.zh: 我撞上墙，墙没有让。
lines.en: I walked into the wall, and it did not yield.

lines.zh: 两个人挤过来，我退了一步。
lines.en: Two people pushed past; I stepped back once.

lines.zh: 我的手擦过你，味道很难洗。
lines.en: My hand brushed you; that smell won't wash off.

lines.zh: 栅栏挡住了我，我卡在缝里。
lines.en: The fence stopped me; I am stuck in the gap.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我没感觉。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot; I felt nothing.

lines.zh: 牛把我顶开了，它比我慌。
lines.en: An ox shoved me aside; it panicked more than I.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上的土会掉。
lines.en: Don't get close; the soil on me keeps falling.

lines.zh: 我撞翻了桶，里面的水是浑的。
lines.en: I knocked over a bucket; the water was cloudy.

lines.zh: 坟里没有新娘，只有我。
lines.en: No bride in the grave, only me.

lines.zh: 死人不生小的，这是规矩。
lines.en: The dead don't make little ones; that's the rule.

lines.zh: 我不找伴，我找坟。
lines.en: I don't seek a mate; I seek a grave.

lines.zh: 同类靠过来，也只是并排站着。
lines.en: Another like me comes close; we just stand side by side.

lines.zh: 土里埋着的，都算我的亲戚。
lines.en: Everyone buried in this soil is my kin.

lines.zh: 没有婚礼，只有同一场雨。
lines.en: No wedding, only the same rain falling.

lines.zh: 它们不牵手，怕手掉下来。
lines.en: We don't hold hands; they might fall off.

lines.zh: 这一片坟地，够我们躺着。
lines.en: This graveyard is wide enough for us to lie in.

lines.zh: 尸群里没有名字，只有位置。
lines.en: In a pack of corpses there are no names, only places.

lines.zh: 谁来都一样，我记不住脸。
lines.en: Whoever comes, it's the same; I can't keep faces.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，我收着。
lines.en: This bone is decent; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 腐肉掉在地上，捡起来还能吃。
lines.en: Rotten flesh on the ground; still edible if I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，手指不听使唤。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly; my fingers won't obey.

lines.zh: 地上的破布，我留着擦脸。
lines.en: A rag on the ground; I keep it for my face.

lines.zh: 这枚钉子，能塞进我的骨头里。
lines.en: This nail could fit into my bone somewhere.

lines.zh: 别人掉的，我都可以要。
lines.en: Whatever others drop, I may take.

lines.zh: 我弯腰要花很久，别催。
lines.en: Bending down takes me a while; don't rush me.

lines.zh: 口袋里已经有四块腐肉了。
lines.en: I already have four pieces of rotten flesh in my pocket.

lines.zh: 捡起来，再掉下去，再捡。
lines.en: Pick it up, drop it, pick it up again.

lines.zh: 我把骨头排在墙根，一排。
lines.en: I line the bones along the wall, one row.

lines.zh: 找到了，你身上有活人的热气。
lines.en: Found you; living heat clings to your body.

lines.zh: 我不急，我知道你跑向哪。
lines.en: No hurry; I know which way you'll run.

lines.zh: 刚才没有目标，现在有了。
lines.en: A moment ago I had none; now I have one.

lines.zh: 你踩断枯枝那一声，够我找到你。
lines.en: That snapped twig was enough for me to find you.

lines.zh: 就是你，别装作路过。
lines.en: You, yes you; don't pretend to be passing.

lines.zh: 我锁住你了，像锁住一扇旧门。
lines.en: I've fixed on you, like a latch on an old door.

lines.zh: 隔着这片林子，我也认得你。
lines.en: Even through these trees, I know it's you.

lines.zh: 别躲进屋里，门挡不住我。
lines.en: Don't hide indoors; a door won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，血在你皮肤下面。
lines.en: I smell it, blood beneath your skin.

lines.zh: 选了就不换，我只跟一个。
lines.en: Once chosen, I don't switch; I follow one.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，我已经决定了。
lines.en: That glance back decided it for me.

lines.zh: 今天的猎物走得比昨天慢。
lines.en: Today's prey walks slower than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 目标站在光里，光不帮我。
lines.en: My target stands in the light; the light won't help me.

lines.zh: 我把你从人群里挑出来了。
lines.en: I have picked you out of the crowd.

lines.zh: 风把味道送过来，我转头了。
lines.en: The wind brings a smell; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 那边有人咳嗽，我记下了。
lines.en: Someone coughs over there. Noted.

lines.zh: 别停，停了我就到你背后。
lines.en: Don't stop; if you stop I'm at your back.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我不会停。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 你翻过那道矮墙，我也翻。
lines.en: You climbed that low wall; I climb it too.

lines.zh: 绕圈子没用的，我记路。
lines.en: Circling won't help; I remember paths.

lines.zh: 你的火把快灭了，是吧。
lines.en: Your torch is nearly out, isn't it.

lines.zh: 再跑十步，你就得喘。
lines.en: Ten more steps and you'll be gasping.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的鞋印，一步一步。
lines.en: I follow your boot prints, step by step.

lines.zh: 前面是河，你会慢下来。
lines.en: There's a river ahead; you'll slow down.

lines.zh: 别喊，附近没有别人。
lines.en: Don't shout; there is no one nearby.

lines.zh: 我在你的影子里走，一直走。
lines.en: I walk inside your shadow, the whole way.

lines.zh: 你听着自己的心跳，我听着。
lines.en: You hear your heartbeat; so do I.

lines.zh: 跑了这么久，你还没甩掉我。
lines.en: After all this running, you still haven't lost me.

lines.zh: 门关上了，我在门外面等。
lines.en: The door shut; I wait outside it.

lines.zh: 你的力气在掉，我的不会。
lines.en: Your strength is dropping; mine does not.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，一次比一次浅。
lines.en: I count your breaths, each shallower.

lines.zh: 你关门时，我从另一边等你。
lines.en: Close the door; I wait on the other side.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草不再响。
lines.en: Where I tread, the grass stops rustling.

lines.zh: 你把背靠在墙上，墙是凉的。
lines.en: You lean on the wall; the wall is cold.

lines.zh: 一爪子下去，指甲断在他肩上。
lines.en: One swipe, and my nail snapped on his shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抓到了，皮很薄。
lines.en: I caught him; the skin was thin.

lines.zh: 咬一口，牙有点松。
lines.en: One bite; my teeth are a little loose.

lines.zh: 我的手按在他胸口，那里是热的。
lines.en: My hand pressed his chest; it was warm there.

lines.zh: 他后退，我跟着撞上去。
lines.en: He stepped back; I crashed into him.

lines.zh: 这一下，够他记到天黑。
lines.en: That blow will stay with him till dark.

lines.zh: 我抓破了他的袖子，布挂在手上。
lines.en: I tore his sleeve; cloth hangs off my fingers.

lines.zh: 他挡了一下，我的手腕歪了。
lines.en: He blocked once; my wrist bent the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我不用力，我只需要抓住。
lines.en: I don't need force; I only need to grab.

lines.zh: 倒下的人，我会蹲下来看。
lines.en: When he falls, I crouch down to look.

lines.zh: 指甲缝里塞满了布和土。
lines.en: Cloth and dirt are packed under my nails.

lines.zh: 他又站起来，那我就再来一次。
lines.en: He stood up again; then I'll do it once more.

lines.zh: 我掐住脖子，手指很凉。
lines.en: I grip the throat; my fingers are cold.

lines.zh: 打完之后，我站在原地不动。
lines.en: After the blow, I stand perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的领口，往暗处拖。
lines.en: I grab his collar and drag him into shade.

lines.zh: 这一下撕开皮肤，血是温的。
lines.en: This tear opens skin; the blood is warm.

lines.zh: 土松了一下，我从下面爬出来。
lines.en: The soil loosened; I climbed out from below.

lines.zh: 这一夜，我又被放出来了。
lines.en: Tonight I have been let out again.

lines.zh: 泥土的味道先钻进鼻腔。
lines.en: The smell of soil reaches me first.

lines.zh: 谁把我叫醒的？没人回答。
lines.en: Who woke me? No one answers.

lines.zh: 月光落在我脸上，我睁眼了。
lines.en: Moonlight touched my face; I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 坟边的草被我压平了一片。
lines.en: I flattened a patch of grass beside the grave.

lines.zh: 关节还没接上，先站一会儿。
lines.en: My joints aren't set yet; let me stand a moment.

lines.zh: 名字忘了，只剩下饿。
lines.en: I forgot my name; only hunger is left.

lines.zh: 从黑暗里出来，眼睛要缓一缓。
lines.en: Coming out of the dark, my eyes need a moment.

lines.zh: 这片地归我了，从现在起。
lines.en: This ground is mine, starting now.

lines.zh: 我从墓碑后面走出来，慢慢。
lines.en: I step out from behind the headstone, slowly.

lines.zh: 有人在附近点了火，我会过去。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire nearby; I will go there.

lines.zh: 骨头重新拼好了，还差一根。
lines.en: My bones are back together, minus one.

lines.zh: 夜刚开始，我还有很多时间。
lines.en: The night is young; I have plenty of time.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道把我从土里叫醒。
lines.en: Rotting flesh wakes me from the soil.

lines.zh: 我从墙根的黑影里长出来。
lines.en: I grow out of the shadow at the wall.

lines.zh: 月光照到第三块碑时，我动了。
lines.en: When moonlight hits the third grave, I move.

lines.zh: 身上的土还没拍掉，先找人。
lines.en: Dirt still on me; first I find someone.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的皮就往里缩。
lines.en: The fire bites; my skin shrinks inward.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我的腿反过来弯。
lines.en: I fell from a height; my leg bent backwards.

lines.zh: 水灌进空胸腔，我沉得很快。
lines.en: Water fills my empty chest; I sink fast.

lines.zh: 炸开的土把我埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast buried me halfway in dirt.

lines.zh: 箭头扎进来，像扎进烂木头。
lines.en: The arrowhead bit in like into rotten wood.

lines.zh: 法术打过来，我的关节全凉了。
lines.en: The spell hit; all my joints went cold.

lines.zh: 饿得手指发抖，可我死不了。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my fingers, but I cannot die.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，骨头亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck me; my bones glowed once.

lines.zh: 脚下的世界空了，我一直在掉。
lines.en: The world beneath vanished; I keep falling.
